# Valerian Pereira

> Head of Data Platform at BookMyShow, based in Mumbai, India. Fifteen years
> building data platforms, APIs and the infrastructure underneath them. Builds
> developer tooling and command-line utilities in the open.

The site at https://valerianpereira.in/ is a single page with two views of the
same content: a SQL console you can query, and a conventional CV below it.
Every fact below is present in the page's rendered HTML and in its
schema.org JSON-LD.

## Current role

- **Head of Data Platform (Engineering Manager III)**, BookMyShow, Apr 2024 –
  present. Owns the data platform end to end: Databricks and AWS
  infrastructure, ingestion and warehousing, data operations, and the reporting
  and reconciliation systems the business runs on.

## Experience

- Engineering Manager III — Head of Data Platform, BookMyShow (Apr 2024 – present)
- Engineering Manager II, BookMyShow (Feb 2022 – Apr 2024)
- Engineering Manager I, BookMyShow (Apr 2020 – Feb 2022)
- Assistant Manager, BookMyShow (Oct 2016 – Apr 2020)
- Senior Software Developer, BookMyShow (Jun 2015 – Oct 2016)
- Senior Software Developer, Softaculous (Mar 2013 – Jun 2015)
- Software Developer, Softaculous (Jun 2011 – Mar 2013)

## Open source

- [backup-action](https://github.com/valerianpereira/backup-action) — GitHub
  Action that backs up MySQL, MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases and directories
  over SSH. 54 stars; published on the GitHub Marketplace.
- [fifa-wc26](https://github.com/valerianpereira/fifa-wc26) — World Cup 2026 in
  the terminal: fixtures, live scores, group standings, ASCII bracket.
- [npx valerianpereira](https://github.com/valerianpereira/npx_valerianpereira)
  — a business card that prints into your shell.
- [who-is](https://github.com/valerianpereira/who-is) — Alexa skill for domain
  WHOIS, expiry and hosting details.
- [alexa-rail-info](https://github.com/valerianpereira/alexa-rail-info) — Alexa
  skill for Indian Railways: cancellations, reschedules, PNR status.
- [webuzo-docker-centos](https://github.com/valerianpereira/webuzo-docker-centos)
  — the Webuzo hosting control panel in a single container.

## Stack

Data: Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB,
MSSQL, Redis. Platform: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Jenkins,
Bamboo, Linux. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, PHP, Bash,
SQL.
